fields.title: 12 dB
fields.text: Filter type: 12 dB. 2-pole filter. Available in Lowpass, Highpass, Bandpass and Notch types. Heard in patches: Leads, Basses, Pads, Keys, Plucks, FX; used as bandpass, highpass, lowpass, notch; e.g. Moving Day In The Caves, Lead With A Bell Attack, Pad Plink 'n' Move, Sticky, Minor 7.

fields.title: 24 dB
fields.text: Filter type: 24 dB. 4-pole filter. Available in Lowpass, Highpass, Bandpass and Notch types. Heard in patches: Basses, Leads, Pads, Keys, Rhythms, Atmospheres; used as bandpass, highpass, lowpass, notch; e.g. Moving Day In The Caves, Pad Plink 'n' Move, Sticky, Minor 7, Major 7 MkII.

fields.title: Legacy Ladder
fields.text: Filter type: Legacy Ladder. 4-pole ladder filter. This is Surge’s original and older ladder filter. It has stable self-oscillation and requires less CPU processing than the newer Vintage Ladder filter. Available in Lowpass type. Heard in patches: Leads, Pads, Basses, Plucks, Atmospheres, Keys; used as lowpass; e.g. Baritonosaurus Saxus, The Elephant Told You, Coteaux du Giennois, The Shoebox, Maj-Min Stab.

fields.title: Vintage Ladder
fields.text: Filter type: Vintage Ladder. 4-pole ladder filter. This is a more recent, accurate and often better-sounding ladder filter. It also has stable self-oscillation, but requires more CPU processing than the older Legacy Ladder filter. Available in Lowpass type. Heard in patches: Pads, Keys, Basses, Leads, Plucks, Drums; used as lowpass; e.g. Boog, Useful, Neptune, Alone, Keep Waiting.

fields.title: K35
fields.text: Filter type: K35. 12 dB/Octave filters from the Odin 2 synthesizer, and inspired by the Korg MS-20 filter topology. Increasing resonance will make them sound dirtier and more aggressive. Available in Lowpass and Highpass types. Heard in patches: Basses, Pads, Leads, Keys, FX, Sequences; used as highpass, lowpass; e.g. Ayay, Hate, Mammoth, Burial, Piercing.

fields.title: Diode Ladder
fields.text: Filter type: Diode Ladder. 4-pole diode ladder filter from the Odin 2 synthesizer with individually tapped pole outputs. This filter attempts to model the sound of a ladder filter that uses diodes instead of transistors. This filter does not self-oscillate without feedback. Available in Lowpass type. Heard in patches: Basses, Pads, Keys, Bass, Leads, Drums; used as lowpass; e.g. 03 The Init Function And State, Hate, Moognt, Acid, Basic Acid.

fields.title: OB-Xd 12dB
fields.text: Filter type: OB-Xd 12dB. 2-pole filters from the OB-Xd synthesizer originally by Vadim Filatov (2DaT), which is based on the filters found in the Oberheim OB-Xa. Available in Lowpass, Highpass, Bandpass and Notch types. Heard in patches: Pads, Keys, Winds, Basses, Plucks, Leads; used as bandpass, highpass, lowpass, notch; e.g. VHS, Cyber Pad, Ghost Past, Unity, Slow Mono.

fields.title: OB-Xd 24 dB
fields.text: Filter type: OB-Xd 24 dB. 4-pole filters from the OB-Xd synthesizer originally by Vadim Filatov (2DaT), which is based on the filters found in the Oberheim OB-Xa. Available in Lowpass type. Heard in patches: Pads, Keys, Basses, Plucks, Percussion, Leads; used as lowpass; e.g. 10 Example - Both Time And Space, 09 Example - Crossfading Oscillators, 11 Example - Reich - Piano Phase, 01 A Simple Formula, 06 Macros And Voice Parameters.

fields.title: Cutoff Warp
fields.text: Filter type: Cutoff Warp. 2-pole filters created using a non-linear biquad filter structure. These non- linearities cause the cutoff frequency to sweep to higher frequencies as the signal level increases (see below). Available in Lowpass, Highpass, Bandpass, Notch and Allpass (Effect) types. Heard in patches: FX, Basses, Pads, Keys, Leads, Drums; used as bandpass, effect filter, lowpass, notch; e.g. 10 Example - Both Time And Space, 04 Vector Valued Formulae, Orbit, Paraphrase, Dark Pulse.

fields.title: Resonance Warp
fields.text: Filter type: Resonance Warp. 2-pole filters created using a non-linear biquad filter structure. These non- linearities cause the resonance of the filter to decrease as the signal level increases (see below). Available in Lowpass, Highpass, Bandpass, Notch and Allpass (Effect) types. Heard in patches: Drums, FX, Basses, Percussion, Mallets, Keys; used as bandpass, effect filter, highpass, lowpass, notch; e.g. Dirty Grime, Meld, Tears Of..., Throwing Glass In A Stone House, Chaos Bits.

fields.title: Tri-Pole
fields.text: Filter type: Tri-Pole. 3-pole filter based on the Threeler filter designed by Ian Fritz, which contains 3 filter stages and a resonance stage in a global feedback loop. Heard in patches: FX, Sequences, Basses, Pads, Percussion, Keys; used as multimode; e.g. Dusty Ambience, Shimmeration, Tasty Hats, 70s Sci-Fi String Ensemble, Black Lights & Nitrous Balloons.

fields.title: Allpass
fields.text: Filter type: Allpass. As its name suggests, this filter passes all frequencies equally in gain. However, it is useful to alter the phase relationship in the spectrum. Unless feedback is involved, its effect can mostly be heard when the Cutoff frequency is in movement. Thus, modulation can be used to get interesting results. Allpass can be found under the Effect category. Heard in patches: Basses, Sequences, Plucks, Pads, FX, Leads; used as effect filter; e.g. Legato Bass, Tape Magic, City Windows, Irrelevant Number, Chimera.

fields.title: Comb + and Comb
fields.text: Filter type: Comb + and Comb. can be found in the Effect category. Heard in patches: Pads, Leads, FX, Keys, Basses, Plucks; used as effect filter; e.g. Embarrass, Violini Poly, Ruler, Split Personality, Clarinet.

fields.title: Sample & Hold
fields.text: Filter type: Sample & Hold. The Sample & Hold module will sample the audio at the rate set by the cutoff frequency. Resonance will emphasize oscillations around the cutoff frequency, not unlike the resonance peak of a lowpass filter. Sample & Hold can be found in the Effect category. Heard in patches: Plucks, Basses, Leads, Pads, Drums, FX; used as effect filter; e.g. Tek Stab, Sizzling Sweep, Zizzly Saw, Call, Messy.
